phase: Independent new-seed confirmation; no screen data pooled

selection.selection_kind: diagnostic best tradeoff; no eligible screen winner
selection.criterion: Largest minimum CPU/mean cost reduction over original and own NOP; fresh confirmation still required.

decision.phase: independent confirmation, frozen before confirmation data
decision.orders: lean_study exact reversed block pairs with rotated starting position
decision.selection: Choose candidate after exploratory screens; use disjoint request seeds and fresh full stacks; do not pool screen data

endpoints.CPU_request: paired log cost-reduction t95 lower bound >0 vs both original and own NOP
endpoints.mean_latency: paired log cost-reduction t95 lower bound >0 vs both original and own NOP
endpoints.p99: noninferiority: cost-reduction t95 lower bound >-2% vs both controls

decision.throughput: Report RPS and interval, but C4 closed-loop RPS and mean are related, not independent evidence
decision.multiplicity: Individual intervals reported; promotion requires every named criterion, no cherry-picking an endpoint
decision.saturation: Repeat selected/reference comparison at C16 near prior measured plateau, same8CPUs; separately interpret it fromC4
decision.time_budget: Aim to begin final confirmations by10:30UTC and finish measurement by12:30UTC for final report before12:52:38

saturation: C16 is near the previously measured throughput plateau on the same8CPUs, not proof of a universal maximum
postroi_worker_snapshot: Lifetime worker CPU only; retained without excluding any performance outlier
